description.value: Skookumchuck Bakery & Cafe is a family-run scratch bakery nestled in the rainforest at the trailhead of Skookumchuck Narrows Provincial Park, famous for its world-class tidal rapids and whirlpools. The bakery is renowned for its 'Skookum' cinnamon buns and serves sandwiches on house-made organic sourdough, espresso drinks, smoothies, and a rotating selection of baked goods using local and organic ingredients. It sits at the end of a short walk along Doriston Highway and makes an ideal stop for cyclists doing the Sunshine Coast before or after the 4 km hike to the Narrows.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms the business is open ('Open for the Season May 19'), matches the OSM address (6694 Doriston Highway, Egmont, BC V0N 1N0), and corroborates the website URL. The about page explicitly mentions 'bikers' as a welcome clientele but no bike parking infrastructure is described anywhere on the site. Hot food is confirmed via breakfast sandwiches and lunch offerings; no bike-specific amenities (parking, water, pump, etc.) are mentioned anywhere in the website content.
concerns: No phone number available in OSM or on the website.
The contact subpage displays 'Hours for 2023 Season' suggesting that page content may not be kept up to date, though the main page banner confirms the current season is open as of May 19, 2026.

Website instructs visitors to 'park on Egmont Road and walk in if you are able,' suggesting vehicle (and possibly bicycle) access directly to the cafe is limited; cycling-specific implications are unclear.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, operating, publicly accessible bakery and cafe at a popular trailhead on the Sunshine Coast — a practical and appealing stop for touring cyclists.
enrichment_extras.notes: The about page explicitly lists 'bikers' among the clientele the business tries to accommodate, alongside hikers and runners, which is a positive signal for cycling-friendliness even though no bike infrastructure is confirmed.

provenance.category_correction_reason: OSM tag is shop=bakery, which maps to Groceries, but this is a bakery and cafe serving prepared food and drinks rather than a grocery retailer. A category of Cafe or Bakery/Cafe would be more accurate.

Basic groceries.detail: Business is a bakery and cafe serving prepared food and drinks; no retail grocery items described

Hot food.detail: Website lists breakfast sandwiches, hot espresso drinks, golden lattes, and sourdough pizza among menu items
